The '''Meirm Dart Frog''' was a truncated [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] model produced by the [[Meirm Speeder Emporium]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Meirm Dart Frog was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as one of the items in the Strategy Alliance Pack.

*[[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]] {{1st}}
